title: File chip
brief: An uploaded-file chip: a coloured file-type tile, the file name with its size, and a small remove button. The chip tints and its border turns teal on hover, and keyboard focus on the button adds a halo around the chip.

inspiration.note: Took the file row with name, status and a remove control; ours is a compact pill chip with a type tile.
Took the removable tag idea with a tinted hover on the close button; colours, tile and mono type label are ours.
